verificationMethod: Expanded all public sheet modules in a browser; extracted only rendered navigation metadata. All 179 normalized records were compared with the local dataset using an identical FNV-1a fingerprint before applying the independently verified LeetCode redirect below.
difficultyMethod: Exact matching against LeetCode's public question__title_slug field. Numeric levels 1, 2, 3 map to Easy, Medium, Hard; spot-checked against the public Majority Element, Koko Eating Bananas, and Trapping Rain Water pages. 145 LeetCode rows matched. No difficulty assigned to 34 TakeUForward practice rows.
normalizations: Trimmed leading and trailing whitespace from problem titles.
Used each row's public TakeUForward practice URL when no external LeetCode problem link was present.
Used the TakeUForward practice URL for order 124 (undirected cycle detection), because its external Course Schedule link is for directed graphs.
Used the TakeUForward practice URLs for orders 130 (Kosaraju) and 171 (Rabin Karp), because the external links target LeetCode discussion/solution posts rather than problem pages.

Order 173: the official sheet's https://leetcode.com/problems/implement-strstr/ redirects to https://leetcode.com/problems/find-the-index-of-the-first-occurrence-in-a-string/. Stored the verified canonical URL/slug for content-script tracking.
limitations: Some LeetCode problems require a paid account. The extension does not bypass access controls.
The official sheet links to related variants for some topics; curriculum titles retain the official sheet wording, not the destination platform title.
Some problems appear under multiple patterns (for example Subsets at orders 40 and 175). Their curriculum IDs and progress remain separate.
The 34 non-LeetCode problems support navigation and manual progress only in V1.
